source_description_html:
Scorpion Serket Parallel Slip-On Exhausts are the modern solution to flat performance and unnecessary weight. Save now on both weight and loss of power by opting for 'Red Power' made possible from the world leader in exhausts. These Serket exhausts feature a distinctive 6 facet profile all around with perfect contours from base to tail. At tail end, you will find the red inlay that sets these apart from all else along with a CNC machined end cap made of material invented in Formula 1 that is capable of withstanding excess temperatures on and off the track. As with all Scorpion Exhausts, these are road legal and come with a lifetime guarantee which speaks volumes for the quality you are investing in.

Adding an aftermarket exhaust to your motorcycle is truly one of the best upgrades you can make. In terms of weight and performance, it's number one.

  • No repacking of exhaust
  • Significant weight savings
  • Optional baffle removal for track day use
  • Optimal dyno tuned performance
  • Plug and play installation with no remap needed
  • Lifetime warranty
Scorpion Exhausts are handmade in Derbyshire, England near the Donington Park Race Circuit. The company is comprised of both car and motorcycle enthusiasts and are one of the only companies to provide a lifetime warranty in the motorcycle industry as a statement to the high quality products they manufacture in house. All Scorpion systems are homologated, independently tested and most importantly, road legal. All exhausts are developed for bike specific applications using the latest technology allowing for a true plug and play fit unlike others. Thanks to this intense focus, these exhausts do not require the motorcycle to be remapped meaning a quick and easy installation with less down time and more two wheel fun!

source_description_html:
The Covert X helmet adds a heaping helping of battle-ready radness to Scorpion's Covert line of helmets and rider wear. Continuing a tradition of configurable utility that started with the original Covert helmet, the Covert X refines and sharpens its hardened urban attitude with new style and features. Now using Scorpion's Ultra-TCT fiberglass technology, the Covert X's shell is lighter, more rigid and offers better impact management. Redesigned front vents and revised internal air channels through the EPS flow air more effectively. The KwikWick 3 liner makes the journey more comfortable than ever before. Included clear and dark smoke drop-down sun visors give an unobstructed view of the tarmac ahead.

Versatility is the Covert X Helmet's greatest hit. The unique design offers three different riding configurations: full-face, three-quarter and half-helmet modes. The molded polycarbonate face mask, rear comfort neck sleeve, ear covers and drop down visor (all included) can be added or removed to drastically adjust the Covert X's look. A single helmet has never done so much. The legend continues.  

Note: Fits a half-size small; consider sizing up if at the middle or higher end of size range. 

Features:

  • Convertible / modular design allows riders to choose from full coverage, three-quarter, or half helmet configurations
  • Front wind / debris guard + full coverage 80mm sun visor gives the look (and "covert" factor) of a full face helmet
  • Fits a wide range of riders, bikes, weather conditions, and attitudes

Shell:

  • Multi-layered Ultra-TCT® shell combines fiberglass, aramid and poly-resin fibers to minimize weight and maximizing strength and impact dispersal
  • Dual density EPS

Shield:

  • Dark smoke SpeedView internal sun visor with EverClear no fog coating installed
  • Includes clear visor for night-time riding

Mask:

  • Easily removable front mask with neodymium magnets included
  • Optional Covert X mask styles available (sold separately; Scorpion "Covert" masks are not compatible) 

Ventilation:

  • Aero-tuned ventilation system

Interior:

  • KwikWick 3 anti-microbial fabric liner / cheek pad system
  • Included cold weather ear covers with integrated Bluetooth speaker pockets

Safety:

  • DOT approved
  • Double D-ring chinstrap system

source_description_html:
Redefining Flip-back Helmets
The EXO-TECH EVO isn’t just another modular helmet—it’s a game changer. With its full-face alike design, wide vision, and Pinlock-ready shield, this helmet sets a new standard of style and performance.
Please experience EXO-TECH EVO’s low-volume shell. Its easy to-use chin bar mechanism and one-touch top vent provide effortless operation and enhanced ventilation.
Elevate your ride with the EXO-TECH EVO – where style, functionality, and value converge.
It offers a superior price-to-performance ratio, catering to various market needs. See, feel, and ride the difference.

City Position
Ratchet system with face shield preset “City Position” allows more fresh air at low speeds.

Anti-fog Sun Visor Coating
Anti-fog coated sun visor provides clear, fog-free vision.

EverClear SpeedView Sun Visor
Retractable SpeedView Sun Visor with EverClear Anti-fog (AF/AF) coating for a clear, fog-free ride. Reduces eye strain in varying light conditions without changing face shields.

Pinlock® MaxVision™ Ready 3D shield
ScorpionEXO faceshield offers superb visisbilty is fitted with Pinlock® MaxVision™ technology for seamless Pinlock® anti-fog integration 

Shield Coating (HD/HD)
Hard coated shield provides clear vision with the anti-scratch properties.

3D Contour Fit
Laser-cut interior foam pads with 3D Contour Fit for enhanced comfort and precision fit.

Aero-Tuned Ventilation
Aero-tuned shell reduces aerodynamic drag, improves balance, and maximizes mobility. Features optimal airflow, pulling heat and humidity out for a cool, dry ride.

KwikFit
KwikFit 3D sculpted cheek pads feature pre-cut channels for easily putting eyeglasses on and off, enhancing comfort and convenience.

KwikWick lll Liner
Anti-microbial fabric keeps you cool and dry in warm weather, warm in cool weather. Fully removable, washable, and replaceable liner with advanced moisture-wicking and odor control. More durable, yet soft, hypo-allergenic KwikWick III Liner enhances your riding comfort.

Mouth Vent (1 Step)
1-Step mouth ventilation.

Comm-Ready Speaker Pockets
Speaker pockets are built into the EPS for your favorite Bluetooth communication system speakers.

EXO-Com Compatible Mounting
EXO-Com compatible mounting adapter included.

Helmet Safety Certification (ECE R22.06)
ECE R22.06 Certified.

P/J Chin Bar
A modular helmet with double homologation (P/J) ensures riding safety with the chin guard open (Jet) and closed (Protective).

Quick Release/One Touch Buckle
The quick-release buckle and strap allow emergency personnel to safely remove helmets by first taking out the cheek pads in accidents, reducing the risk of neck and spine injury.

Core Helmet Sack

Installed Face shield
Clear face shield installed.

Brace yourself for the return of ScorpionEXO’s flip-back masterpiece, now enhanced with a carbon composite shell. The EXO-TECH EVO Carbon is a lightweight marvel, combining effortless operation and convenient features with the added benefit of a chin bar locker for optimal safety.
You need to prepare to be captivated by the EXO-TECH EVO Carbon’s small, sleek, and real full-face-looking shell design. But it doesn’t stop there—immerse yourself in a world of nobility as the premium woven carbon fiber surface adds an extraordinary touch of elegance. This is sophistication at its finest.

Harmonious Integration: Experience true harmony with the EXO-TECH EVO Carbon. Unleash a new level of luxury and performance with the EXO-TECH EVO Carbon. Let the world marvel at your style and embrace the pinnacle of motorcycle helmet innovation.

City Position
Ratchet system with face shield preset “City Position” allows more fresh air at low speeds.

Anti-fog Sun Visor Coating
Anti-fog coated sun visor provides clear, fog-free vision.

EverClear SpeedView Sun Visor
Retractable SpeedView Sun Visor with EverClear Anti-fog (AF/AF) coating for a clear, fog-free ride. Reduces eye strain in varying light conditions without changing face shields.

Pinlock® 120XLT® MaxVision™ Included
Pinlock® 120XLT® MaxVision™  Included in the package

Pinlock® MaxVision™ Ready 3D shield
ScorpionEXO faceshield offers superb visisbilty is fitted with Pinlock® MaxVision™ technology for seamless Pinlock® anti-fog integration 

Shield Coating (HD/HD)
Hard coated shield provides clear vision with the anti-scratch properties.

3D Contour Fit
Laser-cut interior foam pads with 3D Contour Fit for enhanced comfort and precision fit.

Aero-Tuned Ventilation
Aero-tuned shell reduces aerodynamic drag, improves balance, and maximizes mobility. Features optimal airflow, pulling heat and humidity out for a cool, dry ride.

KwikFit
KwikFit 3D sculpted cheek pads feature pre-cut channels for easily putting eyeglasses on and off, enhancing comfort and convenience.

KwikWick lll Liner
Anti-microbial fabric keeps you cool and dry in warm weather, warm in cool weather. Fully removable, washable, and replaceable liner with advanced moisture-wicking and odor control. More durable, yet soft, hypo-allergenic KwikWick III Liner enhances your riding comfort.

Mouth Vent (1 Step)
1-Step mouth ventilation.

Ultra TCT Carbon Shell
ScorpionEXO’s revolutionary Ultra TCT 3K Carbon fiber shell for aircraft-grade impact dispersal. Superior strength-to-weight ratio, digressive integrity, and durability.

Comm-Ready Speaker Pockets
Speaker pockets are built into the EPS for your favorite Bluetooth communication system speakers.

EXO-Com Compatible Mounting
EXO-Com compatible mounting adapter included.

Premium Pull Tab
For easy chin strap adjustment.

Helmet Safety Certification (ECE R22.06)
ECE R22.06 Certified.

P/J Chin Bar
A modular helmet with double homologation (P/J) ensures riding safety with the chin guard open (Jet) and closed (Protective).

Quick Release/One Touch Buckle
The quick-release buckle and strap allow emergency personnel to safely remove helmets by first taking out the cheek pads in accidents, reducing the risk of neck and spine injury.

Installed Face shield
Clear face shield installed.

Prime Helmet Box
Custom designed Prime helmet box with top cover and side towers securely holds and protects the helmet from damage.

Prime Helmet Sack

When your rides regularly take you on and off road, it’s time to consider ScorpionEXO’s new Modular Adventure Helmet ADX-2, the newest offering in Adventure helmets, is an all innovative design and features over others.
Versatility with P/J double homologation and optimal functions for riders who intend to touring, adventure or even dirt bike, regardless of the riding conditions, ADX-2 is fully geared for all you desire.
Hyper-flexible adventure/dual sports modular helmet leads to all of the benefits with conveniently flipping-up the chinbar for a short break time, or swapping the face-shield to goggles for a serious dirt bike experience and also simply removing external peak visor for a better aerodynamic touring purpose.
Ticks all the boxes! ADX-2 is the helmet that possesses a variety of features including internal drop down SpeedView® sunvisor and KwikWick® C liner, providing maximum comfort for all types of adventures.
The inner lining is fully padded with soft fabric that prevents excessive sweating especially for long-distance or hot-day rides.

Versatility with P/J double homologation and optimal functions for riders who intend to touring, adventure or even dirt bike, regardless of the riding conditions, ADX-2 is fully geared for all you desire.
Hyper-flexible adventure/dual sports modular helmet leads to all of the benefits with conveniently flipping-up the chinbar for a short break time, or swapping the face-shield to goggles for a serious dirt bike experience and also simply removing external peak visor for a better aerodynamic touring purpose.
Ticks all the boxes! ADX-2 is the helmet that possesses a variety of features including internal drop down SpeedView® sunvisor and KwikWick® C liner, providing maximum comfort for all types of adventures.
The inner lining is fully padded with soft fabric that prevents excessive sweating especially for long-distance or hot-day rides.

City Position
Ratchet system with face shield preset “City Position” allows more fresh air at low speeds.

Anti-fog Sun Visor Coating
Anti-fog coated sun visor provides clear, fog-free vision.

EverClear SpeedView Sun Visor
Retractable SpeedView Sun Visor with EverClear Anti-fog (AF/AF) coating for a clear, fog-free ride. Reduces eye strain in varying light conditions without changing face shields.

Pinlock MaxVision 3D Shield
MaxVision offers a wide-screen fog-free vision and maximizes the unobstructed view. This ScorpionEXO face shield provides maximum visibility.

Shield Coating (HD/HD)
Hard coated shield provides clear vision with the anti-scratch properties.

3D Contour Fit
Laser-cut interior foam pads with 3D Contour Fit for enhanced comfort and precision fit.

Aero-Tuned Ventilation
Aero-tuned shell reduces aerodynamic drag, improves balance, and maximizes mobility. Features optimal airflow, pulling heat and humidity out for a cool, dry ride.

KwikFit
KwikFit 3D sculpted cheek pads feature pre-cut channels for easily putting eyeglasses on and off, enhancing comfort and convenience.

KwikWick C Liner
KwikWick C Comfort Liner’s anti-microbial fabric keeps you cool and dry in warm weather, warm in cool weather. The liner is easily removable and washable.

Mouth Vent (2 Step)
The 2-steps dual-position mouth vent for comfort riding.

Comm-Ready Speaker Pockets
Speaker pockets are built into the EPS for your favorite Bluetooth communication system speakers.

EXO-Com Ready
Dedicated cavity for seamless connection with EXO-Com.

Helmet Safety Certification (ECE R22.06)
ECE R22.06 Certified.

P/J Chin Bar
A modular helmet with double homologation (P/J) ensures riding safety with the chin guard open (Jet) and closed (Protective).

Quick Release/One Touch Buckle
The quick-release buckle and strap allow emergency personnel to safely remove helmets by first taking out the cheek pads in accidents, reducing the risk of neck and spine injury.

For enhanced fog-free performance.

PUSHING THE BOUNDARIES OF RACING HELMET INNOVATION

Born to Compete. Designed to Lead
The EXO-RACE Air marks a bold new chapter in the ScorpionEXO legacy as the first racing helmet in our premium APEX series. It is meticulously crafted for peak performance, combining elite-level protection, refined aerodynamics, and advanced features tailored for professional racers and high-speed enthusiasts.

Certified for Competitive Excellence
Built to meet the demanding standards of FIM Racing #2 certification, the EXO-RACE Air is engineered to perform under the intense conditions of top-level racing. Whether on the track or at full throttle on the road, it provides exceptional safety, control, and peace of mind.

Spoiler Technology that Adapts to Every Ride
One of the most advanced features of the EXORACE Air is its adjustable rear spoiler. This component extends to increase downforce and high-speed stability during aggressive riding, then retracts for a streamlined shape that reduces drag in casual or urban settings. It provides versatile aerodynamic control, allowing riders to adapt instantly to any condition.

Every Element Designed with Purpose
From the new one-touch ratchet system that allows for smooth and secure visor operation, to the supplemental exhaust vent that expels heat through pressure differentials, every detail is performance-driven.

The Future of Racing Helmets Begins Here
Command every ride with confidence and clarity in the EXO-RACE Air, the most advanced racing helmet ever developed by ScorpionEXO.

AirFit ensures custom comfort for all riding conditions – from canyon rides to long tours. Used by world-class MotoGP racers, AirFit delivers tailored comfort for every rider.

Cool Tech Ventilation System maximizes intake airflow and expels hot air efficiently using air pressure differences. Multi-fabric comfort liners offer improved cooling, sweat absorption, and enhanced wearing comfort with an adjustable crown design and newly designed pattern.

The EXO-R1 EVO II CARBON AIR is built for those who never settle and always ride with purpose.

City Position
Ratchet system with face shield preset “City Position” allows more fresh air at low speeds.

Ellip-Tec ll Ratchet
Enables tool-less, quick-release visor changes in seconds. Latching shield locking mechanism ensures a tight seal against the gasket for secure operation and optimal protection.

Face Shield Lock
Face shield lock for more concealed riding.

Pinlock® MaxVision™ Ready 2D Tear-Off shield

Shield Coating (HD/HD)
Hard coated shield provides clear vision with the anti-scratch properties.

3D Contour Fit
Laser-cut interior foam pads with 3D Contour Fit for enhanced comfort and precision fit.

Aero-Tuned Ventilation
Aero-tuned shell reduces aerodynamic drag, improves balance, and maximizes mobility. Features optimal airflow, pulling heat and humidity out for a cool, dry ride.

AirFit Inflation System
Allows you to personalize fit and reduce wind noise and lift. Using the inflation ball, a snugger fit with fewer pressure points minimizes helmet vibration and lift at higher speeds. KwikFit
KwikFit 3D sculpted cheek pads feature pre-cut channels for easily putting eyeglasses on and off, enhancing comfort and convenience.

KwikWick lll Liner
Anti-microbial fabric keeps you cool and dry in warm weather, warm in cool weather. Fully removable, washable, and replaceable liner with advanced moisture-wicking and odor control. More durable, yet soft, hypo-allergenic KwikWick III Liner enhances your riding comfort.

Premium Pull Tab
For easy chin strap adjustment.

Emergency Release
EMT-friendly, quick-release cheek pads for emergency situations.

Helmet Safety Certification (ECE R22.06)
ECE R22.06 Certified.

Titanium Double-D Ring
High strength titanium D-ring system with industry leading durability.

Breath Deflector (included)
For enhanced fog-free performance.

Clear face shield installed.

description: Pinnacle of Performance: the EXO-R1 EVO II Air Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.
source_description_html:
Pinnacle of Performance: the EXO-R1 EVO II Air
Unrivaled Quality and Performance: Introducing the EXO-R1 EVO II Air, a MotoGP & WSBK tested helmet that sets a new standard for excellence. Its super lightweight TCT Ultra shell is beautifully crafted, embodying the pinnacle of quality and performance.
Masterfully Engineered for Precision and Aerodynamics: The EXO-R1 EVO II Air features a precisely designed shell sculpture, reducing buffeting and allowing you to slice through the air effortlessly. Enhanced ventilation is achieved through a larger top vent that draws in fresh air efficiently, while redesigned exhaust vents expel hot air, keeping you cool and composed.
Crystal Clear Vision: Enjoy unparalleled clarity with the Optical Class 1 shield of the EXO-R1 EVO II Air. The wide eyeport offers a panoramic view of 190° horizontally and 100° vertically, ensuring nothing escapes your sight and enhancing your racing experience.
Unparalleled Features for Every Rider: The EXO-R1 EVO II Air isn’t just for extreme racing conditions; it caters to every rider’s needs. Its improved features ensure a ride like no other, making it the ideal choice for all riding conditions.

City Position
Ratchet system with face shield preset “City Position” allows more fresh air at low speeds.

Ellip-Tec ll Ratchet
Enables tool-less, quick-release visor changes in seconds. Latching shield locking mechanism ensures a tight seal against the gasket for secure operation and optimal protection.

Face Shield Lock
Face shield lock for more concealed riding.

Pinlock® MaxVision™ Ready 2D Tear-Off shield
ScorpionEXO faceshield offers superb visisbilty is fitted with Pinlock® MaxVision™ technology for seamless Pinlock® anti-fog integration. The Pinlock® tear-off posts also ensure the possibility to use tear-off sheets.   

Shield Coating (HD/HD)
Hard coated shield provides clear vision with the anti-scratch properties.

3D Contour Fit
Laser-cut interior foam pads with 3D Contour Fit for enhanced comfort and precision fit.

Aero-Tuned Ventilation
Aero-tuned shell reduces aerodynamic drag, improves balance, and maximizes mobility. Features optimal airflow, pulling heat and humidity out for a cool, dry ride.

AirFit Inflation System
Allows you to personalize fit and reduce wind noise and lift. Using the inflation ball, a snugger fit with fewer pressure points minimizes helmet vibration and lift at higher speeds. AirFit ensures custom comfort for all riding conditions – from canyon rides to long tours. Used by world-class MotoGP racers, AirFit delivers tailored comfort for every rider.

KwikFit
KwikFit 3D sculpted cheek pads feature pre-cut channels for easily putting eyeglasses on and off, enhancing comfort and convenience.

KwikWick lll Liner
Anti-microbial fabric keeps you cool and dry in warm weather, warm in cool weather. Fully removable, washable, and replaceable liner with advanced moisture-wicking and odor control. More durable, yet soft, hypo-allergenic KwikWick III Liner enhances your riding comfort.

Ultra TCT Pre-Preg shell
Revolutionary pre-preg technology developed by ScorpionEXO for unrivaled protection. Multi-layered Ultra TCT Pre-Preg shell combines fiberglass and poly-resin fibers for minimized weight, maximized strength, and superior impact dispersal.

Premium Pull Tab
For easy chin strap adjustment.

Emergency Release
EMT-friendly, quick-release cheek pads for emergency situations.

Helmet Safety Certification (ECE R22.06)
ECE R22.06 Certified.

Titanium Double-D Ring
High strength titanium D-ring system with industry leading durability.

Breath Deflector (included)
For enhanced fog-free performance.

Installed Face shield
Clear face shield installed.

Pinlock® 70 MaxVision™ Included
Pinlock® 70 MaxVision™ Included in the package

Prime Helmet Box
Custom designed Prime helmet box with top cover and side towers securely holds and protects the helmet from damage.

Pinnacle of Performance: the EXO-R1 EVO II Air
Unrivaled Quality and Performance: Introducing the EXO-R1 EVO II Air, a MotoGP & WSBK tested helmet that sets a new standard for excellence. Its super lightweight TCT Ultra shell is beautifully crafted, embodying the pinnacle of quality and performance.
Masterfully Engineered for Precision and Aerodynamics: The EXO-R1 EVO II Air features a precisely designed shell sculpture, reducing buffeting and allowing you to slice through the air effortlessly. Enhanced ventilation is achieved through a larger top vent that draws in fresh air efficiently, while redesigned exhaust vents expel hot air, keeping you cool and composed.
Crystal Clear Vision: Enjoy unparalleled clarity with the Optical Class 1 shield of the EXO-R1 EVO II Air. The wide eyeport offers a panoramic view of 190° horizontally and 100° vertically, ensuring nothing escapes your sight and enhancing your racing experience.
Unparalleled Features for Every Rider: The EXO-R1 EVO II Air isn’t just for extreme racing conditions; it caters to every rider’s needs. Its improved features ensure a ride like no other, making it the ideal choice for all riding conditions.

City Position
Ratchet system with face shield preset “City Position” allows more fresh air at low speeds.

Ellip-Tec ll Ratchet
Enables tool-less, quick-release visor changes in seconds. Latching shield locking mechanism ensures a tight seal against the gasket for secure operation and optimal protection.

Face Shield Lock
Face shield lock for more concealed riding.

Pinlock® MaxVision™ Ready 2D Tear-Off shield
ScorpionEXO faceshield offers superb visisbilty is fitted with Pinlock® MaxVision™ technology for seamless Pinlock® anti-fog integration. The Pinlock® tear-off posts also ensure the possibility to use tear-off sheets.   

Shield Coating (HD/HD)
Hard coated shield provides clear vision with the anti-scratch properties.

3D Contour Fit
Laser-cut interior foam pads with 3D Contour Fit for enhanced comfort and precision fit.

Aero-Tuned Ventilation
Aero-tuned shell reduces aerodynamic drag, improves balance, and maximizes mobility. Features optimal airflow, pulling heat and humidity out for a cool, dry ride.

AirFit Inflation System
Allows you to personalize fit and reduce wind noise and lift. Using the inflation ball, a snugger fit with fewer pressure points minimizes helmet vibration and lift at higher speeds. AirFit ensures custom comfort for all riding conditions – from canyon rides to long tours. Used by world-class MotoGP racers, AirFit delivers tailored comfort for every rider.

KwikFit
KwikFit 3D sculpted cheek pads feature pre-cut channels for easily putting eyeglasses on and off, enhancing comfort and convenience.

KwikWick lll Liner
Anti-microbial fabric keeps you cool and dry in warm weather, warm in cool weather. Fully removable, washable, and replaceable liner with advanced moisture-wicking and odor control. More durable, yet soft, hypo-allergenic KwikWick III Liner enhances your riding comfort.

Ultra TCT Pre-Preg shell
Revolutionary pre-preg technology developed by ScorpionEXO for unrivaled protection. Multi-layered Ultra TCT Pre-Preg shell combines fiberglass and poly-resin fibers for minimized weight, maximized strength, and superior impact dispersal.

Premium Pull Tab
For easy chin strap adjustment.

Emergency Release
EMT-friendly, quick-release cheek pads for emergency situations.

Helmet Safety Certification (ECE R22.06)
ECE R22.06 Certified.

Titanium Double-D Ring
High strength titanium D-ring system with industry leading durability.

Breath Deflector (included)
For enhanced fog-free performance.

Clear face shield installed.

Pinlock® 70 MaxVision™ Included in the package

Custom designed Prime helmet box with top cover and side towers securely holds and protects the helmet from damage.

source_description_html:
Redefining Excellence in Premium Motorcycle Helmets
Unrivaled Safety: Prepare to be amazed by the EXO-GT SP Air’s cutting-edge safety features. We’ve revolutionized the industry with our innovative prepreg shell, combining Chopped & 3K Twill carbon for maximum impact absorption without the added weight. Experience the ultimate in protection – it’s simply awe-inspiring.
Enhanced Vision: Step into the future with the world’s first helmet to feature an aspherical surface design on both the sun-visor and face shield. Our relentless pursuit of perfection has resulted in achieving Optical Class 1 for both components. See the road ahead with unparalleled clarity and precision.
Whisper-Quiet and Refreshingly Cool: We’ve pushed the boundaries of technology to bring you a helmet that delivers a serene and comfortable riding experience. Our ingenious noise-reduction mechanism ensures a quieter journey, while the maximized ventilation system keeps you refreshed and revitalized, even during long rides. Discover the perfect balance between tranquillity and exhilaration.
Uncompromising Quality and User Experience: The EXO-GT SP Air takes a back-to-basics approach, focusing on enhancing the fundamental operating and handling features that matter most to riders. Every aspect has been meticulously scrutinized to ensure a helmet that is not only easy to operate and smooth but also unmatched in quality. This is the epitome of a true Touring helmet—superior in every detail, leaving no competition in its wake.

City Position
Ratchet system with face shield preset “City Position” allows more fresh air at low speeds.

Anti-fog Sun Visor Coating
Anti-fog coated sun visor provides clear, fog-free vision.

Ellip-Tec ll Ratchet
Enables tool-less, quick-release visor changes in seconds. Latching shield locking mechanism ensures a tight seal against the gasket for secure operation and optimal protection.

EverClear SpeedView Sun Visor
Retractable SpeedView Sun Visor with EverClear Anti-fog (AF/AF) coating for a clear, fog-free ride. Reduces eye strain in varying light conditions without changing face shields.

Face Shield Lock
Face shield lock for more concealed riding.

Pinlock MaxVision 3D Shield
MaxVision offers a wide-screen fog-free vision and maximizes the unobstructed view. This ScorpionEXO face shield provides maximum visibility.

Pinlock® 120XLT® MaxVision™ Included
Pinlock® 120XLT® MaxVision™  Included in the package

Shield Coating (HD/HD)
Hard coated shield provides clear vision with the anti-scratch properties.

3D Contour Fit
Laser-cut interior foam pads with 3D Contour Fit for enhanced comfort and precision fit.

Aero-Tuned Ventilation
Aero-tuned shell reduces aerodynamic drag, improves balance, and maximizes mobility. Features optimal airflow, pulling heat and humidity out for a cool, dry ride.

AirFit Inflation System
Allows you to personalize fit and reduce wind noise and lift. Using the inflation ball, a snugger fit with fewer pressure points minimizes helmet vibration and lift at higher speeds. AirFit ensures custom comfort for all riding conditions – from canyon rides to long tours. Used by world-class MotoGP racers, AirFit delivers tailored comfort for every rider.

Cool Tech Liner
Cool Tech Ventilation System maximizes intake airflow and expels hot air efficiently using air pressure differences. Multi-fabric comfort liners offer improved cooling, sweat absorption, and enhanced wearing comfort with an adjustable crown design and newly designed pattern.

KwikFit
KwikFit 3D sculpted cheek pads feature pre-cut channels for easily putting eyeglasses on and off, enhancing comfort and convenience.

Mouth Vent (2 Step)
The 2-steps dual-position mouth vent for comfort riding.

Comm-Ready Speaker Pockets
Speaker pockets are built into the EPS for your favorite Bluetooth communication system speakers.

EXO-Com Compatible Mounting
EXO-Com compatible mounting adapter included.

EXOCOM LINK-1/1C Ready
Dedicated cavity for seamless connection with EXOCOM LINK-1/1C.

Premium Pull Tab
For easy chin strap adjustment.

Emergency Release
EMT-friendly, quick-release cheek pads for emergency situations.

Helmet Safety Certification (ECE R22.06)
ECE R22.06 Certified.

Premium Quick Release / One Touch Buckle

APEX Helmet Box
Custom designed APEX helmet box with top cover, side towers, and bottom tray securely holds and protects the helmet from damage.

APEX Helmet Sack
Soft APEX helmet sack with backpack straps protects the helmet from scratches.

Breath Deflector (included)
For enhanced fog-free performance.

Installed Face shield
Clear face shield installed.

Another Originality & Speciality
The Creator of the original bad-ass Covert/Combat Motorcycle Helmet has now developed a full-face version, the Covert FX! The Covert FX displays the same edgy style and function that is expected from the ScorpionEXO Covert/Combat Series.
However, stylish the details may be, they have important functions. Each helmet is carefully hand-crafted using the latest fiberglass, aramid, and polyresin fibers which provide superior strength and extreme lightweight. The low-profile shell has been aerodynamically tuned for motorcycle riding, minimizing both lift and turbulence for a smoother, quieter, and more stable ride.
Integrated speaker pockets make it easy to install your favorite Bluetooth® communication device, while the KwikWick 3 comfort liner features a moisture-wicking material that will keep you cool, dry, and comfortable during your ride. ScorpionEXO continues to set the new standard when it comes to value in a motorcycle helmet by including a Free Dark Smoke Shield, as well as a Clear shield, right out of the box. If you’re looking for a Stylish and Functional motorcycle helmet that’s perfect for both city commutes and long distance touring, look no further than the Covert FX.

source_description_html:
Another Originality & Speciality
The Creator of the original bad-ass Covert/Combat Motorcycle Helmet has now developed a full-face version, the Covert FX! The Covert FX displays the same edgy style and function that is expected from the ScorpionEXO Covert/Combat Series.
However, stylish the details may be, they have important functions. Each helmet is carefully hand-crafted using the latest fiberglass, aramid, and polyresin fibers which provide superior strength and extreme lightweight. The low-profile shell has been aerodynamically tuned for motorcycle riding, minimizing both lift and turbulence for a smoother, quieter, and more stable ride.
Integrated speaker pockets make it easy to install your favorite Bluetooth® communication device, while the KwikWick 3 comfort liner features a moisture-wicking material that will keep you cool, dry, and comfortable during your ride. ScorpionEXO continues to set the new standard when it comes to value in a motorcycle helmet by including a Free Dark Smoke Shield, as well as a Clear shield, right out of the box. If you’re looking for a Stylish and Functional motorcycle helmet that’s perfect for both city commutes and long distance touring, look no further than the Covert FX.

City Position
Ratchet system with face shield preset “City Position” allows more fresh air at low speeds.

Face Shield Lock
Face shield lock for more concealed riding.

Pinlock MaxVision 3D Shield
MaxVision offers a wide-screen fog-free vision and maximizes the unobstructed view. This ScorpionEXO face shield provides maximum visibility.

Pinlock® MaxVision™ Ready 3D shield
ScorpionEXO faceshield offers superb visisbilty is fitted with Pinlock® MaxVision™ technology for seamless Pinlock® anti-fog integration 

Shield Coating (HD/HD)

Hard coated shield provides clear vision with the anti-scratch properties.

3D Contour Fit
Laser-cut interior foam pads with 3D Contour Fit for enhanced comfort and precision fit.

Aero-Tuned Ventilation
Aero-tuned shell reduces aerodynamic drag, improves balance, and maximizes mobility. Features optimal airflow, pulling heat and humidity out for a cool, dry ride.

KwikFit
KwikFit 3D sculpted cheek pads feature pre-cut channels for easily putting eyeglasses on and off, enhancing comfort and convenience.

KwikWick lll Liner
Anti-microbial fabric keeps you cool and dry in warm weather, warm in cool weather. Fully removable, washable, and replaceable liner with advanced moisture-wicking and odor control. More durable, yet soft, hypo-allergenic KwikWick III Liner enhances your riding comfort.

Mouth Vent (1 Step)
1-Step mouth ventilation.

Comm-Ready Speaker Pockets
Speaker pockets are built into the EPS for your favorite Bluetooth communication system speakers.

Helmet Safety Certification (ECE R22.06)
ECE R22.06 Certified.

Quick Release/One Touch Buckle
The quick-release buckle and strap allow emergency personnel to safely remove helmets by first taking out the cheek pads in accidents, reducing the risk of neck and spine injury.

Breath Deflector (included)
For enhanced fog-free performance.

Core Helmet Box

Core Helmet Sack

Installed Face shield
Clear face shield installed.

source_description_html:
Introducing the all-new ADF-9000 Carbon Air Edition, crafted for the dedicated Adventure Rider.
This enhanced model features a robust and lightweight carbon fiber shell, elevating it above its predecessor. Built with advanced TCT Ultra Technology, the ADF-9000 Carbon Air Edition delivers superior durability and minimal weight. Each helmet is meticulously crafted for top-tier quality.
The Exolon® Peak Visor, made from shatter-resistant material, reduces buffeting at high speeds and can be easily removed for highway riding or low sun conditions.
For off-road adventures, the helmet includes a tool-free face shield removal system, allowing quick transitions to goggles. The wide eye port enhances peripheral vision and fits most goggle sizes and brands.
A signature feature of ScorpionEXO helmets is the AirFit® liner inflation system, enabling customized cheek pad fit to reduce wind noise and lift.
Whether tackling global routes or casual rides, the ADF-9000 Carbon Air Edition offers exceptional comfort, safety, and confidence, making it the ultimate All-Road, All-Weather helmet. The new carbon fiber shell takes it to the next level, providing unmatched strength and lightness for any terrain.

City Position
Ratchet system with face shield preset “City Position” allows more fresh air at low speeds.

Anti-fog Sun Visor Coating
Anti-fog coated sun visor provides clear, fog-free vision.

EverClear SpeedView Sun Visor
Retractable SpeedView Sun Visor with EverClear Anti-fog (AF/AF) coating for a clear, fog-free ride. Reduces eye strain in varying light conditions without changing face shields.

Face Shield Lock
Face shield lock for more concealed riding.

Pinlock MaxVision 3D Shield
MaxVision offers a wide-screen fog-free vision and maximizes the unobstructed view. This ScorpionEXO face shield provides maximum visibility.

Pinlock® 120XLT® MaxVision™ Included
Pinlock® 120XLT® MaxVision™  Included in the package

Shield Coating (HD/HD)
Hard coated shield provides clear vision with the anti-scratch properties.

Smoke Shield installed
Smoke Shield installed.

Laser-cut interior foam pads with 3D Contour Fit for enhanced comfort and precision fit.

Aero-Tuned Ventilation
Aero-tuned shell reduces aerodynamic drag, improves balance, and maximizes mobility. Features optimal airflow, pulling heat and humidity out for a cool, dry ride.

AirFit Inflation System
Allows you to personalize fit and reduce wind noise and lift. Using the inflation ball, a snugger fit with fewer pressure points minimizes helmet vibration and lift at higher speeds. AirFit ensures custom comfort for all riding conditions – from canyon rides to long tours. Used by world-class MotoGP racers, AirFit delivers tailored comfort for every rider.

KwikFit
KwikFit 3D sculpted cheek pads feature pre-cut channels for easily putting eyeglasses on and off, enhancing comfort and convenience.

KwikWick lll Liner
Anti-microbial fabric keeps you cool and dry in warm weather, warm in cool weather. Fully removable, washable, and replaceable liner with advanced moisture-wicking and odor control. More durable, yet soft, hypo-allergenic KwikWick III Liner enhances your riding comfort.

The 2-steps dual-position mouth vent for comfort riding.

Ultra TCT Carbon Shell
ScorpionEXO’s revolutionary Ultra TCT 3K Carbon fiber shell for aircraft-grade impact dispersal. Superior strength-to-weight ratio, digressive integrity, and durability.

Available action cam mounting plate.

EXO-Com Compatible Mounting

Premium Pull Tab

High strength titanium D-ring system with industry leading durability.

With a heritage spanning over 120 years Triumph have been responsible for some of the world’s most iconic models from “the world’s first superbike” the Thunderbird in the 1940’s, the world land speed record breaking 650 Bonneville of the 50’s and the first ever 100 MPH lap on a production motorcycle again the Bonneville at the IOM TT in 1969.
